title: Volcanic Eruption Styles
subject: Geography
description: This diagram illustrates how magma viscosity and gas content determine the style of volcanic eruptions, distinguishing between explosive and effusive types.
mermaidCode:
graph TD
A[Magma Properties] --> B{Viscosity & Gas Content}
B --> C[High-viscosity (acidic/felsic) magma]
C --> C1(Traps gases)
C1 --> C2[Explosive Eruptions]
B --> D[Low-viscosity (basic/mafic) magma]
D --> D1(Allows gases to escape)
D1 --> D2[Effusive Eruptions]
